crossRefs.note: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

translations.web: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.
translations.bsb: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
translations.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
translations.asv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
